__doc: WHAT THE PRODUCTION COMPARISON IS ALLOWED TO FIND, AND WHY.
WARNING: THE LIVE SITE IS NO LONGER THIS BRANCH'S BASELINE.
sunbeam-school-lemon.vercel.app is built from origin/main, which on
2026-09-01 advanced seventeen commits past 53aaf25 - the commit this CMS work
is based on. Those commits took the tree back to a FLAT Astro site: no apps/,
no apps/cms, and data/navigation.ts deleted outright. It is a deliberate
frontend-only track, not a regression, and nothing in this migration caused it.
So the two trees are cousins, not versions. Comparing them whole will always
differ, and a comparison that always differs tells you nothing. This file is
what separates the noise from the signal - and every entry names its cause, so
no difference is waved through on the grounds that it was there yesterday.
baseline  - production is on the other lineage; the difference is not ours
migration - we changed this deliberately, and it is recorded where
anything else is an unexpected regression and must be zero
note: local is 0 ahead / 19 behind origin/main; merge-base is 53aaf25. Since the last check origin/main added 4550d55 (mobile design) and 874bb64 (Parents’ Feedback page).

baseline.why: origin/main deleted apps/web/src/data/navigation.ts in dfb1ab1 and rebuilt the utility bar elsewhere, adding a Uniform Catalogue link to it. This branch's utilityLinks is byte-identical to 53aaf25 and never contained one. Production has the word twice per page (utility bar + footer); this branch has it once (footer).
baseline.verifiedBy: git show dfb1ab1 -- apps/web/src/data/navigation.ts (605 deletions, 0 insertions)
baseline.wordsNote: Single words, because the comparison is word-frequency: the phrase never appears as one token.

baseline.why: origin/main added /admission-notice/ and retired /admissions/ in e1b0119, and carries an admission-notice pill this branch removed at G2. Different lineage, not a loss.

origin/main rewrote the redirect stub template in e1b0119 ("fix 13 dead redirects"). Production renders "Redirecting… This page has moved."; this branch renders "Redirecting to: X from Y". Same destinations, different wording.
origin/main set the school name in capitals in one heading. A casing change on the other lineage, not a content loss.
origin/main renamed a heading on that page. Different lineage.

origin/main added a Parents’ Feedback page in 874bb64 ("update new page", +895 lines: ParentsFeedbackPage.astro, parentsFeedback.ts, parents-feedback.astro) and one nav entry for it in src/data/navigation.ts:330, inside the Parent Partnership group. The page and the entry exist ONLY on that lineage - `git grep` finds neither in 53aaf25 nor in the working tree - so every route that carries the nav loses those two words against production. Nothing in this migration removed them; they were never here.
baseline.evidence: git show --stat 874bb64 · git grep "Parents’ Feedback" origin/main -- src/data/navigation.ts

migration.why: Eighteen activities added from the school's two photograph folders; the chronicle grew from 10 to 18 and from 2 pages to 4.
Two existing celebrations gained the photographs they were waiting for; Independence Day's page carried a 'photographs not yet supplied' placeholder.
District Junior Volleyball Championship added as a sports record.
The Shooting Range facility is the archery range, confirmed by the school. Renamed in all seven places it appeared, with a redirect off the published address.
Four Parents' Forum photographs replaced with real Parent-Teacher Day ones; descriptions changed with them.
G7's approved data-* plumbing from the CMS to the page scripts.
The Shooting Range → Archery Range rename reaches the campus index.

baselineRoutes.why: Redirect stubs. origin/main rewrote the stub template in e1b0119 and retired /admissions/. Same destinations, different wording — the whole text of these pages is the redirect notice, so the diff is the template.
origin/main replaced the empty Conference Room slide with the Book Fair (44e7b8b) and the route no longer exists there. It still exists on this branch.

PRODUCTION IS AHEAD HERE, not behind. Those three pages carry photographs on origin/main that this branch has not received — this branch still shows their "photographs not yet supplied" placeholder. The frontend-only track got that batch first.
